title: Marco Leal re-interviews Carlos about 25 years later

tellings.quote: "Wow, your account is exactly the same as the one you gave 25 years ago. Identical. Not a single detail has changed."

plain: Carlos de Souza, a surgeon from São Paulo, Brazil, says that in 2021 an interviewer named Marco Leal questioned him again about events at his hospital, which the episode describes as an operation on an alien, about 25 years after his first interview. De Souza tells Michels that Leal said: "your account is exactly the same as the one you gave 25 years ago. Identical. Not a single detail has changed." He tells it as a sign that his story has stayed the same over time.
